name: Simplitryon
author: MirrAR

sections.description:
Using Simplitryon you can offer immersive shopping experiences to your customers by making virtually try your products in real time. Simplitryon is the world’s first and fastest Augmented Reality (AR) Virtual Try On platform that lets your customers to virtually try Jewellery, Eyewear and Wrist Watches on them before they make a purchase decision.

At MirrAR we strive to make the online shopping experience as close to that of the offline shopping through innovative technology. We offer omni-channel solution, using our truly touchless solution your customers can visiting your offline store could try products in a small kiosk (iPad/Tablet) or a large TV. Just by waving their hands using gestures they try different products on them digitally.

Simplitryon has state of the art face & hand detection technology and supports multiple product types like Necklace, Earrings, Rings, Bracelets, Bangles, Wrist Watches, Eye wears, apparel and other accessories.

Our mission is to make Simplitryon as a new normal technology and make it accessible to every e-commerce business and revolutionize the online shopping experience. We are a real passionate team shaping the new world, join our mission and transform your customer experience.

This plugin adds virtual try-on functionality to your WordPress website using MirrAR technology. It includes a JavaScript file loaded from an external CDN.

NOTE: This plugin’s new tab and New window option is only Available when you permalinks in Plain like https://wordpress.com/?p=123

External services

This plugin connects to mirrar CDN to obtain the Tryon information. it’s needed to show the tryon in the included widget.

External JS Used:
The plugin uses the following external JavaScript resource:
– (https://cdn.mirrar.online/js/init.min.js)
– Mirrar’s TOS and Privacy Policy

This script is essential for the virtual try-on feature and is loaded dynamically during the relevant interactions.
sections.faq:
How to get the API Keys?

  1. Open https://developer.mirrar.in and create your account, subscribe to a plan and get the API Keys.

Where to insert the API Keys in plugin

  1. Click Simplitryon plugin settings, after that we can see Simplitryon API Settings.
  2. In this tab, we can see two text box for API Key and Secret Key.
  3. Enter the Fields with respective data you got from Simplitryon team.

How to Set Tryon Product

  1. Open Products and Add New, After Entered the API Keys, We can see the option Simplitryon Button Option in Product Creation Page.
  2. Click Simplitryon Button Option, the we can see Enable/ Disable for Tryon and Category.
  3. Check that Enable option and the we can set the Category.
  4. There are respective fields based on Category.
  5. Those fields contains our Tryon Image Also, Which one is trying by customer.
  6. After that only we can try the product.

How to Set Custom Tryon Button Design

  1. Click Simplitryon plugin settings, after that we can see Simplitryon General Settings.
  2. In this tab, we can see Several Text Boxes and Color pickers, By those fields we set the custom button design. We can also review on the right side.

HTTACCESS Changes

  1. Add the Following line of Code in .httaccess file in your Store.

Code:

RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule ^tryon-page/?$ index.php?tryon-page=1 [QSA,L]
